title: Blob upload does not validate Content-Type header
description: kith-attach blob upload handler stores whatever Content-Type the uploader supplies without validation. A peer can upload a blob with content_type='text/html' or 'application/javascript' and clients that serve it back with that type become XSS vectors. Fix: validate that content_type parses as a valid MIME type; consider allowlisting common safe types or stripping dangerous types before storage.
